name: Product breakdown
about: Starter for a knowledge map of one product. Generic headings only: rename, delete and fill them. Everything it adds comes in "to verify".

items.title: Overview
items.notes: What the product is, what it is used for, and where it fits in a system. Two or three sentences a newcomer can read first.

items.title: Range
items.notes: Sizes or capacities offered, from the smallest to the largest, and how the range is split into models or series.

items.title: Model name
items.notes: How to read the model name or code: what each part of it means.

items.title: Components
items.notes: The main parts, one branch each. Under a part: what it does, the choices offered, and what to check.

items.title: Options and accessories
items.notes: What can be added or changed, and what each option needs or excludes. Link options that go together or exclude each other.

items.title: Performance and ratings
items.notes: The figures that describe the product, each with its unit, the conditions it is rated at and the standard it comes from.

items.title: Standards and certifications
items.notes: The standards the product is designed, tested or certified to, one branch each, with what each one covers.

items.title: Selection
items.notes: How the product is chosen for a job: the inputs needed, the steps, and the usual mistakes.

items.title: Installation and commissioning
items.notes: What the site must provide, the order of work, and the checks before handover.

items.title: Service and maintenance
items.notes: Routine tasks and their intervals, spare parts, and common faults with their causes.

items.title: Common questions
items.notes: Questions customers and colleagues ask often, one branch each, with the answer in its notes.
